repo_state_note: No lower-campaign computation exists in this repository, and `repo_state` is `none` for that reason. What does exist is the binding record: `engine/carriers/MANIFEST.json` binds `jets.py` (`CR-JETS`, from the DER-027b INCOMPLETE draft, mpmath, `certifying: false`) to this lane rather than to A1, where it sat until 2026-09-18 as if its Taylor jets were the upper chart's 24-jet set — which the source never says — and `tools/carriers_verify.py` recomputes every bound blob's digest against that manifest. Binding an input records which bytes exist and where; it is not review, not replay and not endorsement. Until 2026-09-22 this note said only that no computation exists, naming neither. `repo_state` describes only what code exists in this repository. It is not a mathematical status and no verdict, promotion or discharge may be read from it.
